label: Maximal esse causality from common ancestry, composition and causal ascent (inference)
rule: Collapse existing actual esse-cause ancestry; causal ascent identifies each maximum with that same source
meaning: Analyst source-first alternative for the selected-esse genus premise. The existing common ancestor supplies one actual n and a finite nonempty actual esse-cause path to each other actual being. Reuse causeOfChain under the existing composition law to obtain CausesIn n x esse. The existing causal-ascent premise then places n above any distinct maximal m, contradicting m's maximality; explicit excluded middle gives m=n. Thus every merely maximal bearer has n's universal esse-causal scope. No order-to-cause converse, greatest-degree calibration, uniqueness of tied degrees, Fourth-Way genus causality or God naming is assumed. Common-source identity and uncausedness are retained parts of an existing reusable interface but unused by this proof. The source/composition/ascent premises remain open to independent warrant and actual application; the tenseless, mode-unspecified profile is not thereby a present productive support relation. This supports the existing fixed-esse premise, not the stronger all-respects d9fad785 premise. See docs/notes/maximum-definition-fork.md.
